_comment: Tier-2: the PFEM applications are not distributable on a pip stack. Pitfall (kratos.pfem_fluid #0) says PfemFluidDynamicsApplication, DelaunayMeshingApplication, PfemSolidMechanicsApplication and PFEM2Application are not published on PyPI. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). None of the four imports (ModuleNotFoundError), while the reference applications used across this catalog do — so the fixture discriminates between 'absent from this build' and 'nothing is installed'. Confirmed independently against the index: pip reports no distribution for KratosPfemFluidDynamicsApplication, KratosDelaunayMeshingApplication, KratosPfemSolidMechanicsApplication or KratosPFEM2Application at any version. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS every claimed availability flag in CASES -- it asserts the opposite of what this install actually provides, leaving the importlib.import_module probe itself untouched. All 6 importable[...] lines then disagree with themselves and app_import_mismatches goes from 0 to 6. This is the control the fixture needs: it proves the printed booleans come from a real import attempt on this build and that a wrong availability claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 6 importable[<app>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, app_import_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/pfem_applications_absent && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
